name: The Cinder Lark — Cockpit
baseDescription: Cracked amber-glass canopy plates frame the rust-haze of the Drift. Copper-braided ley conduits hum behind the throttles, smelling faintly of hot ozone and burnt lubricant.

descriptionVariants.text: Red telltales blink across the instrument cowling. Somewhere aft, a buckled rib groans with every attitude-thruster pulse.
With your upgraded arrays online, the nav-slate projects crisp blue ley-vectors deep into the outer reef—clear past the Syndicate listening buoys.
An amber transponder-warning LED blinks steadily on the lower cowling—Halden's cutter or customs sweep tagged your hull signature.

name: The Cinder Lark — Magi-Tech Bay
baseDescription: A bolted slate workbench sits wedged between the reactor bulkhead and a rack of scorched plasma cells. Silver-etching needles and flux-solder wait under a swinging brass lamp.

descriptionVariants.text: Twin sigil-splicer arms now overhang the slate, humming in sympathetic resonance whenever you lay raw aether shards beside cold steel.
Scorch-rings and faint blue runes stain the benchtop—proof of custom magi-tech hardware forged by your own hands.

name: Siltport Outpost — Landing Pad
baseDescription: Red iron dust swirls across cracked ferro-concrete slabs. A hand-painted windsock snaps over a rusted gantry while moisture vaporators wheeze along the perimeter fence.

descriptionVariants.text: Freshly welded crane trusses tower over the pad, floodlit by amber arc-lamps. Hydraulic hoses hiss as dockhands haul scrap pallets clear.
From the converted freighter hull on the east berm, the Runesmith's Foundry vents rhythmic plumes of blue-white induction sparks.
Vexra Korr leans against a fuel drum near the pad, calipers in one grease-stained hand and a glowing ley-capacitor in the other.
Word of the Kestrel blackbox and Vane-Kael's forged tariff ledger has begun to ripple through the gantry crews.
Gantry floodlights burn steady over Siltport's repaired pad—no longer a dying scrap-yard, but a port whose name carries across the Drift.

name: Siltport Outpost — Rust & Cantina Row
baseDescription: Corrugated tin awnings sag over a narrow alley of battery-peddlers and scrap-brokers. The Copper Kettle's shutters rattle in the dry wind, waiting for someone to bankroll its hearth.

descriptionVariants.text: Warm amber light spills from the Copper Kettle's open doors. Freebooters argue over star-charts while spiced rust-gin and synth-smoke drift into the alley.
Across the lane, the Signal-Glass Archive's restored crystal spools cast pale cyan latticework across the dust.
Old Iron Bramwell holds court by the corner brazier, trading Syndicate patrol timings for battered hull plates.
The Syndicate tariff booth stands shuttered and stenciled with Siltport's free-port seal—dockhands walk taller under the tin awnings.
Ledger Syndicate customs banners hang beside the Copper Kettle. Cargo moves smoothly, though every crate carries a stamped tax seal.
Syndicate inspectors still patrol the main lane, yet look the other way whenever your ship's sigil passes the gantry.
A fresh chalk tally-mark is scratched beside Sister Mirek's tin shutter—a quiet reminder of the favor you owe her.
Freebooter couriers pull their collars up and go silent whenever your boots crunch past the corner brazier.

name: Kestrel Wreckage
baseDescription: The courier brig Kestrel hangs bisected in a slow-tumbling gravel eddy. Torn copper rune-cables whip lazily from its severed spine, and an amber distress ping pulses every six seconds.

descriptionVariants.text: With the main cabin breached and its blackbox pulled, the Kestrel drifts quieter now—still rich with exposed conduits and unpicked hull plating for bold scavengers.

name: Kestrel Fore-Hull
travelLockedHint: Decode the Kestrel blackbox to pinpoint the fore-hull's drift vector.
baseDescription: Half a courier brig hangs canted inside a slow-spinning ring of vitrified glass shards. Its severed steel edges catch the starlight like dark obsidian, and a faint amber pulse flickers behind the forward bridge viewport.

descriptionVariants.text: The forward ward-bubble is dark and vented now—its relay-key stripped, its last survivor safely aboard.
Ice crystals glitter inside the breached bridge canopy. The Kestrel's prow drifts cold and silent in the Mid-Drift.

name: The Slag Foundry
travelLockedHint: Requires Mid-Drift navigation vectors from the Kestrel blackbox.
baseDescription: Two decommissioned ore-barges welded snout-to-snout form a roaring Ironkin salvage foundry. Induction arcs spit blue-white sparks into vacuum while magnetic grapples haul shattered Tariff War plating into the crucibles.

descriptionVariants.text: Forgemaster Durn's dockhands flash Siltport's amber recognition strobe as your hull approaches the berth.
Shadows linger along the upper catwalks—freebooter runners watching every docking clamp that locks onto the barge.

name: Syndicate Buoy 14
travelLockedHint: Requires Mid-Drift navigation vectors from the Kestrel blackbox.
baseDescription: A bristling slate-gray customs spire anchored to a metallic asteroid. Twin rotating dish-arrays sweep the Mid-Drift lanes, relaying tariff ledgers and deep-rim quarantine telemetry.

descriptionVariants.text: Its exterior running lights still blink green in rhythmic ignorance, unaware its encrypted audit partition was siphoned clean.
Scorched plating and a dead port sensor mast mark where you forced the customs spire open.

name: The Glass Shoals
travelLockedHint: Requires Ley-Braided Drive Lv. 2 or Aether-Spectrum Sensors Lv. 2
baseDescription: Dozens of ancient and modern vessels hang frozen inside a slow-turning reef of vitrified hull-glass. Starlight refracts through translucent prows in long, singing prisms.

descriptionVariants.text: Captain Tessa's courier hull, the Starling, drifts quiet at the center of the reef—its echo-core safely aboard your ship.
Pale cyan ley-ribbons now thread cleanly between the glass wrecks, guiding deep-rim pilots past the shear.

name: The Listening Abbey
travelLockedHint: Requires Ley-Braided Drive Lv. 2 or Aether-Spectrum Sensors Lv. 2
baseDescription: A hollowed iron comet studded with brass acoustic dishes and leaded-glass lancets. Inside its pressurized nave, robed Choir remnants tend humming quartz tuning-spires.

descriptionVariants.text: Cantrix Vey's acolytes flash warm amber docking lamps along the comet's ridge as The Cinder Lark approaches.
The Abbey's outer shutters remain sealed—watching your ship with wary, silent brass dishes.
With the Monolith silenced, the comet's quartz spires stand mute—its acolytes packing relics for a quiet exodus.

name: Black-Site Anchor-9
travelLockedHint: Requires Ley-Braided Drive Lv. 2 or Aether-Spectrum Sensors Lv. 2
baseDescription: A matte-gray Syndicate dread-ring suspended in deep vacuum, bristling with cold-iron grounding lances aimed squarely at the Singing Monolith's sector.

descriptionVariants.text: The grounding lances stand powered down—Vane-Kael's crew monitoring the Deep Frontier beside you rather than firing.
Dark and adrift, Anchor-9's firing ring spins slowly with its command relays locked cold.
Shattered lance-pylons tumble around the ring's scorched core—a silent monument to a broken blockade.

name: The Singing Monolith
travelLockedHint: Requires Ley-Braided Drive Lv. 2 or Aether-Spectrum Sensors Lv. 2
baseDescription: A three-hundred-meter obelisk of matte-black basalt hangs upright in vacuum, ringed by shattered rings of ancient brass. A low chord vibrates straight through your ship's bulkheads into your teeth.

descriptionVariants.text: Pale cyan script now crawls slowly up the monolith's fluted faces, answering the tuning fork tucked in your gear.
The obelisk hangs dark and mute in vacuum—its singing rings snapped cold by your grounding spike.
Scorch-scars mar the basalt plinth where you bled its harmonic core dry, leaving only a faint metallic hum.
